Refuse every foreign active owner identified in the executable script position, including recover_plus.py, with OWNER_LIFECYCLE_HOLD. An allowed scientific PGID does not exempt an independently active foreign owner. Do not hide the owner through tracked-group projection.

Retain only the existing exact detached-parent exception: supplied allowed_parent PID, actual --start-detached owner script in execution position, and the exact script identity permitted by that handoff route.
